note: SYNTHETIC example case - illustrates the interface; not a formal test case
task: Organise an 8-minute lab-meeting talk on paper_synthetic.pdf for speech-recognition colleagues who know CTC but not mixture-of-experts. Goal: the group can decide whether to try GateLite for its own low-resource languages. 8-10 main slides plus up to 2 backup slides; prepare likely questions.

constraints.audience: speech-recognition lab, knows CTC, not MoE

output_contract.talk_plan: goal, audience, section time budget, key messages, transitions
output_contract.deck: editable pptx with speaker notes + PDF/PNG previews
output_contract.evidence_map: slide -> paper locator with verbatim quotes
output_contract.qa_preparation: likely questions with answer points, evidence and backup slides
output_contract.render_and_version_record: source files, exports, fonts/template, change log
